name: Cyprus
contextBlurb: Cyprus applies MiCA to stablecoin issuers and crypto-asset service providers. Fiat-referenced tokens are legal only inside the EU authorisation framework, with reserve, redemption, white paper, custody, governance and AML obligations. CySEC supervises much of the crypto-asset market conduct perimeter.

legislation.title: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA)
legislation.summary: EU stablecoin framework for EMTs and ARTs, directly applicable in Cyprus.

news.headline: MiCA information for crypto-asset service providers

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Cyprus follows MiCA. Stablecoin issuance is allowed with restrictions for authorised EMT and ART issuers; passporting is available for compliant EU issuers.

regulators.name: Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission
regulators.role: National supervisor for crypto-asset market conduct and MiCA authorisation matters in Cyprus.
